Umbrella for the 2026-11-07 batch-process remediation. It is never a batch member; batch notes go here.

2. Batch mode becomes owner opt-in; one feature branch per feature is the default.
3. Drop the member-check review.
4. Delete the aborted batches' branches (delete-aborted-hold-e2e-batch-branches-20261107).

Sequence:
(1) Register the batch from current origin/develop, with each member's scope derived from its item plus its changelog fragment.
(2) Dispatch members as separate top-level sessions with distinct TODO_DB_ACTOR values, and start the serial tooling item in its own worktree at the same time.
(3) Land and prepare members, merge develop if needed, run the fast tier and pr-preflight, open the final PR with make pr-open, bind it, run batch-evidence, wait for CI and the oracle, arm, and merge.
(4) Land the serial PR the same way.
(5) Finish the members, the serial item and the branch item, then this umbrella.

Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, or the batch targets for members); never edit the primary clone; stage paths explicitly; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or oracle gate; re-read each cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because line numbers drift.
